bio.text: Brandon Wade, a Democrat, is a candidate for Oklahoma's 2nd Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election.

According to Ballotpedia's profile, which draws on candidate-provided information, he was born in Bartlesville, Oklahoma, graduated from Copan High School, and has worked as a laborer in the oil industry.
The same profile lists him as a union committee chairman and executive board member of IUOE Local 351.
